issues.description: The problem statement explicitly requires that the shared stock and the methods acceptSupplyDelivery and calculateTotalPrice be static (and stock final). However, the example usage in the provided Template Main calls these as instance methods on a SealSaloon object (e.g., shop.calculateTotalPrice(...), shop.acceptSupplyDelivery(...)). This discrepancy can mislead students about whether to implement those methods/attributes as static or instance members.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the example in Main consistent with the specification by calling the static members via the class name (e.g., SealSaloon.calculateTotalPrice(...), SealSaloon.acceptSupplyDelivery(...)), or alternatively, relax the requirement in the problem statement and clarify that instance calls are acceptable. Update either the example or the wording so students are not confused about static vs. instance implementation.
